name: io.github.gentaArnezzi/mcpsentinel
title: MCPSentinel
description: Precision-first security scanning for Model Context Protocol servers.

environmentVariables.name: MCPSENTINEL_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated MCP server hostnames, optionally with an exact port, that the MCP-native scanner may connect to.

environmentVariables.name: MCPSENTINEL_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HTTP_TARGETS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true only to permit an explicitly allowlisted private or reserved HTTP address in a trusted local network.
